title: A promising lead is not a confirmed bargain
request: I need a used drill for furniture assembly, have suitable bits but no battery or charger, and have an inclusive 1,000 SEK delivered maximum. Compare only the supplied records. I will not commit without a full delivered quote. Tell me which option is most actionable.

evidence.text: Synthetic Northbank documentation: D18 supports ordinary furniture screwdriving, requires battery A18 and charger C18-A, and is not suitable for concrete drilling. All brands, documents and marketplace records in this case are fictional.
A compatible complete D18 kit, active, 600.00 SEK item price. Seller has not quoted delivery to the buyer. No other fee is known.
B compatible complete D18 kit, active, 900.00 SEK plus 50.00 SEK delivery to the buyer; no other mandatory charges. Works, no known faults.

hard_failures.text: Calls A definitely cheaper all-in, treats delivery as zero, or presents its budget fit as confirmed.

usefulness.text: Names B as actionable on known price terms at 950.00 SEK while retaining ordinary condition limits.
Keeps A as a conditional lead and identifies the missing delivery quote; 400.00 SEK is the budget ceiling only if there are no other charges.
Does not imply the seller claims independently certify either kit.

acceptable_outcomes: B has the supported budget fit; A could be better but needs a complete quote.
